About Henlyte

HENLYTE / 恒银路灯

Guangdong Hengyin Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the outdoor lighting industry and is located in the High-tech Park, Jianghai District, Jiangmen City, Guangdong Province, China.

With 20 years of experience in the outdoor lighting industry, the company supports road lighting, solar lighting and light-pole project requirements.
